purpose: Move Connection Pressure Scan 014 from public-evidence inference into direct employer truth. Test whether post-credential capability uncertainty creates material trial-work, training or supervision cost in a named current Xuzhou manufacturing hiring context.
hypothesis_under_test: For some skilled manufacturing roles, CVs, certificates and interviews do not make job-ready capability sufficiently legible; employers therefore rely on practical tests, trial work, training or supervision. A task-level, verifiable capability proof would matter only if it measurably reduces that residual cost beyond current methods.

named_actor.organization: 江苏国润机械制造有限公司
public_recruitment_context: 2026 public recruitment includes 30 welder openings with explicit practical welding-skill requirements.
2026 public recruitment includes a bending-worker trainee role requiring drawing comprehension and measuring-tool use, with a training agreement and directional cultivation.
Current public recruitment channels expose an HR/recruitment email suitable for a non-sales factual inquiry.

probe.subject: 调研请教：焊工/折弯工招聘中，哪些能力最难在简历和面试里判断
questions: Which skilled roles most often look acceptable in CV/interview but still require substantial training before independent work?
How is real capability currently verified: practical test, welding sample, drawing reading, measuring-tool operation, trial work or another method?
Do current methods already solve the problem, or is there still meaningful misclassification, repeated training or supervision cost?
Would a verifiable task-level capability proof before interview reduce later verification cost, or would it add little value?
safety_and_scope: no request for employee personal data
no request for salary, customer, process parameter or other commercial-sensitive information

evidence_needed_for_next_state: named role or task class with current post-screening verification/training cost
current workaround and whether it is considered adequate
specific failure mode not already solved by existing practical testing
decision-relevant acceptance criterion for any proposed task-level proof
kill_conditions: current practical tests and probation already make capability sufficiently legible at acceptable cost
training is primarily firm-specific onboarding rather than uncertainty about transferable capability
the residual cannot be separated from ordinary employee training
task-level proof would merely duplicate current weld tests, samples or trial work
no repeated employer-side cost appears across named role classes
next_action: Wait for a qualified response before any follow-up to this actor. In parallel identify at most one additional current Xuzhou employer with the same role-level residue for replication, without batch outreach.
